angle: Helping HDB owners choose the right property upgrade strategy by asking fundamental questions, using a unique investment scorecard.
body_text:
What should you REALLY do after MOP? Most HDB owners are asking the wrong question.

You’re earning well. You’ve made gains.

Yet the next move feels confusing.

Hey, it’s Chris Pang here.

I’ve been speaking to many HDB owners earning $20K/month and above.

Most just hit MOP.

Most have solid paper gains.

Most are ready to upgrade.

But when it’s time to decide, they get stuck.

One big 4-bedroom condo?

Or split into one for stay, one for investment?

Here’s the truth:

Most HDB upgraders are asking the wrong questions.

They ask:

→ “Which project has the highest growth?”

→ “Which location is safest?”

But the real question is:

“What strategy fits my income, my goals, and my family’s next 10 years?”

✅ Lifestyle vs growth

✅ Stress vs flexibility

✅ One big move vs a structured plan

That’s why I created the 15-Point Project Investment Scorecard, the same framework I use to help clients:

✅ Choose the right upgrade strategy (not just what they can afford)

✅ Spot projects with real upside potential

✅ Move forward with clarity, not guesswork

If your MOP is coming up and you’re feeling uncertain

Click “Learn More” and I’ll send it over to you.

No pressure. No hard sell.

headline: Unsure what to do next? Find out more =>
transcript_text: Is your HDB reaching MOP but you're not sure what to do? Recently, I've been speaking to many HDB owners who have a household income of $20,000 and above. Most of them are about to hit MOP and have solid paper gains and they are ready to upgrade, but they feel very uncertain and stuck. Should they buy one big 4-bedroom condo or should they buy one for own stay and one for investment? I know it's confusing because everyone's advice is different. Hi, I'm Chris Pang. I help HDB owners move with confidence and clarity without compromising their lifestyle or overstretching their finances. Now, here's the truth. A lot of HDB owners are asking the wrong questions. There are things like, which project has the highest growth potential? Which location is the best? Can I afford one without stretching too much? But the real question to ask yourself is this. What strategy fits my income, my goals, and my family's 10-year horizon? It's understanding what strategy fits your life. For example, a 20k a month household might be able to afford a 2 million condo or a split strategy with a 1.5M condo and a rental property. Both works, but you need to ask yourself, what do you actually want? Is it for lifestyle? For early retirement? What are your family priorities? kids and school, what resources do you have today? Your income, your CPF, your risk appetite? Without clarity on this, you're just guessing. That's why I created a 15-point investment scorecard. It is the exact framework that I use to help my clients to identify which upgrade strategy fits their life, evaluate projects with strong upside potential, and make confident, data-backed decisions before their next move. For the last 16 years, I have advised and helped 400 plus clients gain clarity using this system. If you're thinking about upgrading, but you're feeling uncertain, just click on learn more and I'll send it over to you.
